title: Hourly weather graphs: temperature, pressure, wind speed and wind direction
description: Four stacked hourly weather charts plotted from midnight through 11 p.m.: temperature, dew point and normal high/low (°F/°C), barometric pressure (in Hg/hPa) showing a sharp drop around 1 p.m., wind speed and gust (mph/km/h) with two gust points in the early afternoon, and wind direction in degrees (N/W/S/E) as a scatter of points. The page carries no caption or narrative text and accompanies a MUFON case report.
